propositions: Subpackage import failures and scripts/ module sys.path issues escaped the existing single-import CI probe

A deterministic walk must import every module under the installed rebar package and all top-level scripts/ modules, reporting all failures (not fail-fast), with expected-optional modules skipped only when their declared optional dependency is absent
Scripts/ modules must be imported in isolated child processes (scripts dir stripped from sys.path) so one script's sys.path.insert cannot mask a sibling's missing import
The walk is invoked in the wheel-probe CI step and locally runnable without CI dependency via make import-walk or direct script invocation
Expected-optional table entries (rebar._mcp_auth, rebar.opcert_service.app, rebar.review_bot.app) and t5c_calibrate.py skip are documented with explicit reasoned justifications
